evidence: Plaut. Cas. 976: In adulteriō, dum moechissat Casinam, crēdō perdidit.
Cic. de Or. 2.275: quī in adulteriō dēprehenditur (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Quintilian’s definition: adulterium est cum aliēnā uxōre coīre (7.3.10, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: In adulteriō, dum moechissat Casinam, crēdō perdidit.
phrases.english: He lost it in adultery, I suppose, while he was having his way with Casina.
